hooks.logic:
Let v2 be the script register, then the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
If not (the enemy → is-invisible or the enemy is judged dead), then
  If condition flag "is_fawaray" is up this frame, then the enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: "06"}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
  If not a move is already queued, then
    If the enemy can act and the enemy is ready to act, then
      If util passes a fraction roll of the numeric entry "head_prior_warning_rate" in v2, then
        The enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: "03"}], [{messageSuffixNo: "04", buddyId: the character AURON}]]}.
        Choose state 12 next.
      Otherwise, the enemy → without-and-lot-and-register-ability with ({forceIgnoresReflection: false}).

hooks.logic:
The script register.
If not the enemy → is-invisible and not (the enemy is judged dead), then
  If condition flag "is_fawaray" is up this frame, then the enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: "06"}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
  If condition flag "any_damage" is up this frame, then
    The enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: "05"}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
    Choose state 11 next and stop.
  Otherwise, if condition flag "poison_breath_countup_turn" is up this frame, then
    The enemy uses the move labelled "poison_breath" immediately.
    Choose state 11 next and stop.
  Otherwise
    If the enemy is ready to act, then the enemy uses the built-in move DO_NOTHING.
    Stop.
